card.name: Verb after dialysis or diagnostic procedure
card.fires_on: The small word (is, will, to) right after a procedure noun such as hemodialysis, dialysis, or a diagnostic test, just before a statement about using it or what it does.

modes.label: After dialysis
modes.description: The linking word 'is' or 'will' directly after dialysis or hemodialysis in overdose or lactic acidosis text.

modes.label: Before diagnose
modes.description: The word 'to' after a procedure or test, leading into the verb diagnose.
modes.example: A biopsy is done<< to>> diagnose Ewing sarcoma.

card.writes: It seems to push toward technical verbs and terms that follow a procedure, and away from words like custom and oral.
card.plain: It fires on the little word after a procedure like dialysis or a biopsy, just before the text says what the procedure is for or whether it helps.
